Water (H₂O)

Solid

Solid State

Particles are tightly packed in a regular crystal lattice. Kinetic energy is low, resulting only in vibrational motion.

Liquid State

Kinetic energy has overcome some attractive forces. Particles flow while remaining in close contact.

Gaseous State

Particles move independently at high speeds. Intermolecular forces are negligible.

Plasma State

High energy has ionized the atoms, stripping electrons. Highly conductive and magnetic.
